About GERMANIA AUTOZENTRUM

GERMANIA AUTOZENTRUM brings carefully selected used cars from Germany to customers across Spain and Europe. We take care of the whole process, from choosing the vehicle to the import paperwork and delivery to your door, so you can buy with confidence.

Our cars come with a European warranty. Whether you want to buy, sell or export a car, our team is here to help.

Financing

Pay in instalments with a minimum 20% deposit. The balance is paid over time, interest-free.

Import and delivery

We handle all import paperwork from Germany and deliver the car to your home in about 5 days.
